box_tampon.name: Box of PAX Tampons
box_tampon.flavorText: Promising protection and discretion, sanitary products like these are a luxury that few in the Lower Levels can afford.

packet_red_cigarette.name: Pack of Hemingway Cigarettes
packet_red_cigarette.flavorText: The most luxurious smoking experience one can have, with a flavor, and a price tag, that makes sure you remember it.

pack_condom.name: Box of REX Condoms
pack_condom.flavorText: Surprisingly common in the Lower Levels thanks to a subsidised distribution program. Population control, after all, is cheaper than riot control.

shampoo.name: Bottle of 4 In 1 Wash
shampoo.flavorText: Shampoo, conditioner, body wash and toothpaste, all in one convenient bottle, with rejuvenating Nutrifruit extract.

toothpaste.name: Tube of Toothpaste
toothpaste.flavorText: A minty gel that promises fresh breath.

toilet_paper.name: Roll of Toilet Paper
toilet_paper.flavorText: Affordable toilet paper that offers strength and reliability. Two-ply is a luxury in the Lower Levels.

water_test_container.name: Water Testing Kit
water_test_container.shortDescription: A small bottle of color strips used to test water quality.

water_test_strip.name: Water Testing Strip
water_test_strip.shortDescription: A testing strip used to accurately determine the quality of a water sample.

aquascan.name: AquaScan
aquascan.shortDescription: A device used to accurately determine the quality of a water sample. Displays detected impurities.

uv_filter.name: UV Lamp
uv_filter.shortDescription: Can be used on a water container.
uv_filter.flavorText: A lamp that emits ultraviolet light to kill bacteria and other microorganisms.

metal_scanner.name: Scav Scanner
metal_scanner.shortDescription: A device that improves your chance of finding valuables when scavenging. (You can only benefit from one Scav Scanner at a time.)
metal_scanner.flavorText: Ever wanted a third eye? Or a second nose? Cut through the clutter with a Scav Scanner!

gene_scanner.name: Gene Scanner
gene_scanner.shortDescription: Can be toggled on to reveal the full genetic makeup of an animal.

water_tablet_container.name: Bottle of Water Purification Tablets
water_tablet_container.shortDescription: A small bottle of tablets used to purify water.

water_tablet.name: Water Purification Tablet
water_tablet.shortDescription: Eliminate large amount of microbial contaminants and partially reduce chemical contaminants. No effect against other types of contaminants.

water_filter.name: Water Filter
water_filter.shortDescription: Slightly improves water purity when used inside a filter system. Ineffective above a certain threshold.

water_filter_adv.name: Advanced Water Filter
water_filter_adv.shortDescription: Will recover 50 durability at the start of each day.
water_filter_adv.flavorText: A premium water filter for pitchers used in the Upper Levels. Slowly self-cleans.

portable_water_purifier.name: HydraTech Micro Water Purifier
portable_water_purifier.shortDescription: Use on a water container to bring its contents up to Basewater purity, whatever's in it. It will use 1 durability per 100ml.
portable_water_purifier.flavorText: A disposable advanced water purifier, common in the Upper Levels. The discarded ones wash up in the Dumping Grounds, still good for a few more pours.

water_pitcher.name: Water Pitcher
water_pitcher.shortDescription: Holds a water filter to strip some contaminants from the water poured through it.

water_tank.name: Water Tank
water_tank.shortDescription: A large liquid container. Use scrap metal or a metal ingot on it to enlarge it.

hydroreed_filter.name: Hydroreed Filter
hydroreed_filter.shortDescription: Remove certain type of contaminants when used inside a filter system
hydroreed_filter.flavorText: A biological filter grown from Hydroreed.

kotton_fabric.name: Kotton Fabric
kotton_fabric.shortDescription: Used in chemistry to strain large particles from liquids. Far too coarse for water purification.
kotton_fabric.flavorText: A versatile fabric made of organic fibers. Commonly used for reinforced workwear and shock-insulating wraps.

nutrient_tablet.name: Hydroponic Nutrient Tablet
nutrient_tablet.shortDescription: Contains minerals that are essential for plant growth. Can be added to a water container.
nutrient_tablet.flavorText: Do Not Consume. For hydroponic use only.

nutrient_tablet_container.name: Hydroponic Nutrient Tablet Bottle
nutrient_tablet_container.shortDescription: A bottle containing hydroponic nutrient tablets
nutrient_tablet_container.flavorText: Do Not Consume. For hydroponic use only.

lottery_ticket.name: Lottery Ticket
lottery_ticket.shortDescription: The winning numbers are revealed each Saturday morning.
lottery_ticket.flavorText: A jackpot ticket could buy you a lifetime in the Upper Levels' safety and comfort.

lottery_ticket_old.name: Old Lottery Ticket
lottery_ticket_old.shortDescription: A worthless ticket from the Lower Levels Lottery. No winning numbers, just faded hope.
lottery_ticket_old.flavorText: A jackpot ticket could buy you a lifetime in the Upper Levels' safety and comfort.

skincare_cream.name: ETERNAL Rejuvenation Serum
skincare_cream.shortDescription: A sought-after luxurious serum designed to rejuvenate and restore skin using ethically sourced stem cells.
skincare_cream.flavorText: A sleek glass jar containing a shimmering serum.

neuroactive_perfume.name: SYNC Neuroactive Perfume
neuroactive_perfume.shortDescription: Use to boost trading bonus by 15% with the current customer. You can only benefit from the effects of one perfume at a time.
neuroactive_perfume.flavorText: Developed from grief therapy research, this perfume use adaptive scent-mapping tech to evoke positive personal memories. Common in high-end hospitality venues, where workers found that the tips earned by wearing the perfume more than make up for the price tag.

self_refilling_neuroactive_perfume.name: SYNC Self-Refilling Neuroactive Perfume
self_refilling_neuroactive_perfume.shortDescription: Use to boost trading bonus by 15% with the current customer. You can only benefit from the effects of one perfume at a time. Refills on its own.
self_refilling_neuroactive_perfume.flavorText: The premium edition of the SYNC perfume. A sealed reservoir in the cap slowly synthesizes a new dose, so the bottle never quite runs dry.

pheromone_perfume.name: L'ESSENCE Pheromone Perfume
pheromone_perfume.shortDescription: Use to boost trading bonus by 25% with the current customer. You can only benefit from the effects of one perfume at a time.
pheromone_perfume.flavorText: An illegal fragrance formulated from engineered human pheromones. It pushes attraction and emotional receptivity. Despite being illegal, it is highly sought after by social climbers in the Upper Levels.
